issues: Probe 'core-ca-ragged-row' has an incorrect check_ids annotation: it lists ['trajectory_tables_structure', 'backbone_domain_rmsd'], but the mutation removes the last field from core_ca_rmsd.csv, so the affected scientific check is 'core_ca_rmsd' (the executed report indeed shows core_ca_rmsd failed with 'ragged row at line 41' while backbone_domain_rmsd passed; passed_control is recorded false). The mutation itself is scientifically valid and the grader behaved correctly; only the expected-check annotation is wrong. Fix check_ids to ['trajectory_tables_structure', 'core_ca_rmsd'] and re-run this control on the revised candidate.

Probe 'nonfinite-value-resid' has the same annotation defect: it sets 'inf' in resid_weighted_rmsd.csv row 57 but lists check_ids ['trajectory_tables_structure', 'backbone_domain_rmsd']. The executed report correctly fails 'resid_weighted_rmsd' (and trajectory_tables_structure) while backbone_domain_rmsd passed; passed_control is recorded false. Fix check_ids to ['trajectory_tables_structure', 'resid_weighted_rmsd'] and re-run.

The public acceptance rule states that 'quoted numbers ... fail', but the grader's csv.reader with the default dialect silently unquotes RFC-quoted fields, so a file containing properly quoted numeric fields (e.g. "6.823686867261616") would parse and pass value comparison. This is a documented-rule/implementation mismatch (in the lenient direction) that can make the grader accept a submission the published contract rejects. Either enforce quote rejection (e.g. csv.reader with quotechar disabled / rejection of fields containing quote characters in the raw text) or remove/correct the 'quoted numbers fail' clause in the addendum, then re-run the affected controls (at minimum the reference, alternative and representation controls) on the revised candidate.
rationale: Scientifically sound candidate: all five notebook endpoints are preserved (three exports copied verbatim, two recovered via faithful reruns of unchanged source calls with verified determinism); the public question's definitions (backbone N/CA/C/O, domain-group post-fit RMSD without re-centering, mass-weighted domain columns, reader-derived DCD times, 98 frames) were each verified against the pinned MDAnalysis 2.11.0 source (selection.py BackboneSelection, rms.py _prepare/_single_frame, DCDReader time convention), and the mass-weighting migration to groupselections is genuinely present in the executed code, justifying the public question over the notebook's contrary prose. Tolerance floor (3e-6 Å = 2x the max measured float32-vs-float64 discrepancy of 1.5e-6 Å) is properly calibrated against an independently executed NumPy/Kabsch implementation that passes, while probes show wrong methods and 5e-6 shifts fail; path resolution, row alignment, nonfinite/ragged/whitespace rejection, missing/empty/misplaced controls and representation-alternative controls all behave as documented. However, acceptance is withheld: two probes ('core-ca-ragged-row', 'nonfinite-value-resid') carry copy-paste check_ids naming 'backbone_domain_rmsd' instead of the actually-affected file-specific checks (core_ca_rmsd / resid_weighted_rmsd), so those controls are recorded as failed despite the grader behaving correctly against a valid mutation; the annotations must be corrected and those controls re-executed. Separately, the addendum's claim that quoted numbers fail is contradicted by the grader's csv.reader, which unquotes quoted fields, so quoted numbers would pass — a public-contract/implementation mismatch that must be reconciled (enforce or reword) with affected controls re-run. These are correctable annotation/wording defects, not scientific scope changes or weakened coverage, hence 'revise' rather than 'blocked'.

source_coverage.rationale: The AdK RMSD notebook contains five terminal scientific results: (1) Universe-level backbone + CORE/LID/NMP unweighted trajectory RMSD, (2) AtomGroup CORE alpha-carbon RMSD, (3) mass-weighted RMSD, (4) residue-number-weighted RMSD, and (5) the static open-vs-closed backbone RMSD. The preparation plan exported only (2)-(4) (the ones surviving as named DataFrames at script completion) and excluded (1) and (5) on grounds that would normally be invalid ('R and df are overwritten later'; 'computed as an unnamed standalone expression'). The construction lawfully recovered both excluded endpoints via the permitted endpoint_recovery path: the unchanged original calls (rms.RMSD(u, u, select='backbone', groupselections=[CORE, LID, NMP], ref_frame=0) and rms.rmsd(backbone, backbone, center=True, superposition=True)) were rerun on the same pinned inputs (byte-identical MDAnalysisTests 2.11.0 PSF/DCD/CRD, hash-verified in the derivation provenance) at the required state (fresh Universe at frame 0), with determinism verified across two fresh runs and recovery kept separate from the recorded exports. So no eligible branch is missing: all five are required public outputs with dedicated grader checks. Plots are correctly excluded as visualization-only projections of the same DataFrames. I verified against the pinned MDAnalysis 2.11.0 source that the public definitions match the executed semantics: BackboneSelection bb_atoms={N,CA,C,O} excluding OT* (core/selection.py 1309-1322); groupselections computed after the global fit with center=False/superposition=False against raw reference group coordinates (analysis/rms.py 733-741, 803-824); weights='mass' propagating to groupselections because the string is not iterable (analysis/rms.py 691-697, 706-707), confirming the public mass-weighted domain columns follow the executed code rather than the notebook's contrary prose; DCD times derived from header delta/nsavc/istart (coordinates/DCD.py 157-162, 239-245) as the public question states. Input descriptions (98 frames, closed 1AKE / open 4AKE provenance, same topology, PSF masses) agree with the evidence. The public question adds the two recovered endpoints and defines weighting semantics per executed code; this is authorized endpoint recovery plus a truthful correction of a false narrative claim, not a scientific scope change.
remaining_validation: After the probe check_ids corrections and the quoted-numbers rule reconciliation, re-run all controls (especially 'core-ca-ragged-row' and 'nonfinite-value-resid', plus reference/alternative/representation controls if the grader or addendum text changes) on the revised candidate hash.
